title: lomatium graveolens var. alpinum
intro: Lomatium graveolens var. alpinum, commonly known as Alp lomatium or Fern-leaved lomatium, is a plant species within the Carrot or Apiaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which can aid in the treatment of respiratory infections, fever, and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of Alp lomatium include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as expectorant and antispasmodic properties.
